# Poodle Core

> Poodle offers a behaviour layer, a style framework, and opinionated components.

Use the version in the package.json beside this file. Replace VERSION in
each URL with that exact version (the release tag is vVERSION).

- Supported behaviour exports: https://github.com/inflatable-cookie/poodle/blob/vVERSION/docs/contracts/core-behaviour.md
- Svelte async tag combobox recipe: https://github.com/inflatable-cookie/poodle/blob/vVERSION/docs/guides/015-async-tag-combobox.md
- Appearance recipe hooks: https://github.com/inflatable-cookie/poodle/blob/vVERSION/docs/knowledge/architecture/007-appearance-recipe-contract.md

## Preview policies from @inflatable-cookie/poodle-core

- moveActiveOption(items, activeValue, move, wrap = true) and
  reconcileActiveOption(previousItems, items, activeValue) take ordered
  items with stable string values and optional disabled flags (default false).
  Supply the active value or null and handle keyboard events, focus and ARIA.
- selectionTransition(selected, event, options?) handles select, toggle,
  remove, clear and replace without reading visible items. Mode defaults to
  single. Multiple mode defaults to no maximum. Supply a stable key for
  records, candidate eligibility and the current selection. Store the
  returned selection and decide which options to show.

If the tag or a document is absent, these instructions are newer than the
installed release or the build has no release tag. Check the build's source
revision and use only exports verified against that installation.
